description.value: The study investigated whether the dopamine D2 receptor TaqIA polymorphism was associated with brain response to heroin-related cues during fMRI in heroin-dependent individuals receiving methadone maintenance treatment and healthy controls.

value: Specifically, the A1+ patients show more intense brain activation in prefrontal, mesolimbic system and visuospatial-attention related regions relative to A1− patients.

description.value: Forty-nine male heroin-dependent individuals under methadone maintenance treatment and 20 healthy control subjects performed a heroin cue-reactivity task during functional magnetic resonance imaging.
